=== Passionate ===

Passionate: [http://www.signingsavvy.com/sign/PASSIONATE/2053/1 C-hands move down the chest repeatedly]

=== Self Love ===

Self: [http://www.signingsavvy.com/search/self A hand taps chest repeatedly]

Love: [http://www.signingsavvy.com/sign/LOVE/255/1 Both arms are drawn to the body and cross over in front of the chest.]

Self-Love: Tap chest with A hand twice (as in Self) and with both A hands once (as in love).
